# gg-pdf

> PDF export backend for gg's recording system. A blank import registers the "pdf" backend: draw with
> `recording.Recorder` (the gg drawing API), then play the recording back into `recording.NewBackend("pdf")` and save
> it. For multi-page documents with metadata, use `pdf.NewDocument`. Supports solid fills and strokes, linear and
> radial gradients, fill/stroke/clip paths, transforms, stroke styles (width, cap, join, dashes) and Save/Restore.
> Known limits: sweep gradients fall back to their first stop color, text uses Helvetica only, and a clip can only be
> undone through Save/Restore. PDF writing uses coregx/gxpdf. Go 1.25+, zero CGO. Pre-1.0: the API may change
> before v1.0.
